svg.text: FurniCraft: PostgreSQL schema as implemented, all 16 tables and auth.users
Types: ts = timestamptz, num = numeric, int = integer. Each line runs from a foreign key column (crow’s foot) to the table it references (bar), always to that table’s primary key.
One-to-one: user_profiles.id, shop_subscriptions.shop_id and order_costings.order_id are each both the primary key and a foreign key.
Unique (user_id, shop_id, peer_user_id) on conversation_read_state and (shop_id, customer_user_id) on shop_reviews. conversation_read_state.peer_user_id has no foreign key.
Generated from the live PostgreSQL schema (public schema, 16 tables, 32 foreign keys) on 9 October 2026. auth.users is managed by Supabase Auth.
